documentation.content: A runtime setting in `config/runtime` was changed from the owner console (`owner_settings_changed`: `settings` (ids), `sensitive` (the ids among them that can pause the service, raise a spending ceiling, change what users are charged or given, allow sandbox purchases or weaken a brake; the line is a warning when there is any), `changes` (`id`, `from`, `to` for plain values), `uidHash`, `change`, the `ownerSettingChanges/` id with every before and after). If you did not change it, change it back on the console or with `npm run admin -- config reset <id> --apply` (or `config set`), remove the account from `config/owner`, and read `ownerSettingChanges/` in the Firestore console. See functions/README.md, "The owner console". Changes made with the admin command are logged to the `admin` log and not alerted on.
